source.title: [Bounty #743] Validate /api/notifications payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

POST /api/notifications forwards req.body directly to createNotification without schema validation. Any JSON object is accepted, including missing userId, missing notification type, empty message text, excessively long payloads, and prototype pollution fields. The in-memory notification store then persists malformed notification entities, degrading client notification feeds and causing runtime render errors.

## Requested fix

Add a strict Zod schema for notification creation and validate the request in notificationController before persistence. Require valid userId string, require standard notification type or bounded string, require non-empty message text up to 1,000 characters, allow optional link string up to 500 characters, and reject malformed payloads with a 400 Bad Request error envelope. Add focused route/service tests for valid payload, missing fields, empty/oversized message, and unknown property rejection.

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty. I will submit a PR that references this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700
